style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, warm daylight
motion_rule: the camera orbits her without stopping and reverses at 2.25, 4.15 and 7.4, so rails of coats and shelves tear past behind her; she walks down the aisle in EVERY beat, never breaking stride, throwing her whole body into one big gesture in EVERY beat; the courier moth crosses through the lens hauling folders in EVERY beat; new shot size every beat; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat with a huge collar chewed ragged, powdery wings, feathered antennae
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a headset, always within a wing of the lens, hauling folders in every beat
props: ONE dark coat she pulls off the rail, wears, then carries; ONE paper the courier hands her at 7.4
environment: a bank storage room, a long aisle between rails of coats and shelves, tall windows

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, flat and bored, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-4.15 one breath, short breath at 4.15, 4.15-7.4 one breath; after 7.4 only sfx
audio.pronunciation: BA-bush-ki-nu, do-YE-la, BA-bush-ku, do-YE-li, dol-GHI, za-TO, i-po-TE-ke
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable in every spoken beat, head up, face clear, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hangers screeching, fur ripping, paper tearing, a rail rolling at 5.85

timeline.a: the frame opens full of hanging fur and she tears through it into the lens, a dark coat snagged across her shoulders, face clear
she sweeps a row of bare hangers back past her shoulder, clattering off the lens
she boots an empty box ahead of her, tumbling down the aisle past the lens
she rips an armful of folders off a shelf in one wide swing
she hurls them back over her shoulder, paper bursting across the frame
she stamps through the spilled folders, wings beating them away
chest-up: she pulls that coat off herself and carries it out on both arms, like a body
she drops it in the aisle and steps clean over it without looking down
wide: she shoves a loaded rail away, the coats streaming past her
she hauls her chewed collar off one shoulder and swings it sideways past the lens, still on her wing
the courier shoves a paper at her on the run and she bites the corner off it, walking on
she throws the chewed collar back on like a stole and flings both wings wide
she swings round into the lens and blows a cloud of grey fur off her wing straight at the camera
chest-up: she walks on at the lens through the settling fur, working the stole, grinning wide

must_appear: opens on fur filling the screen, she tears through it by 0.3; the first word is heard at 0.0; the camera keeps orbiting her in every beat; the courier is in frame every beat; at 7.4 she bites the corner off the paper; at 8.8 the fur cloud hits the lens; at 9.4 she grins straight at the camera
